### SC576 — Alien
**Broad category:** Monster  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Coherent nonhuman biology unconstrained by terrestrial body templates while remaining a premium female character. Distinguishing vocabulary includes nonhuman biology; novel sensory systems; unusual joints; unfamiliar substrate..

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Alien can invent a coherent non-terrestrial biological plan across skull, sensory organs, limb count or articulation, skin/substrate, respiration, internal cavities, hair analogue, hands/feet and proportion. The key is one biological logic: unfamiliar eyes may imply different cranial support; novel limbs require new joints and torso roots; unusual surfaces must connect to actual tissue or structural systems. Human-compatible routes can concentrate alienness in head, skin and distal anatomy, while extreme routes may radically rework the whole body.

**Materialization modes.** non-terrestrial sensory organs; novel joint/limb plan; unfamiliar substrate; alternative respiration or cavity systems; nonhuman distal anatomy; unconventional cranial architecture; new surface organs; alien proportion logic.

**Body-regime range.** Supports subtle almost-human aliens, petite delicate forms, athletic multi-jointed bodies, broad dense organisms, elongated ethereal bodies and radically nonhuman female-preserving anatomies.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may define the alien substrate, energy/material economy, topology, appendage function, sensory medium or growth logic. Alien reciprocally frees partner concepts from terrestrial anatomical defaults while requiring the final body to remain internally consistent rather than arbitrary.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Elegant, uncanny, alluring, biomechanical-looking, ethereal or radically other female identities with extremely broad design space.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must be engineered around the resolved alien joints, sensory organs, appendages and substrate boundaries. Familiar garment archetypes may be restructured, but the body is never normalized to fit them.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Alien can influence weapon design through unfamiliar grip interfaces, nonhuman proportion, novel material transitions and unconventional secondary geometry after a recognizable weapon category has been established.

#### Interpretation boundary
A human female character with unusual skin colour, antennae tokens or random sci-fi markings is insufficient; Alien requires coherent non-terrestrial body biology.

### SC577 — Symbiote
**Broad category:** Monster  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Dual living-body system in which a secondary organism is inseparably rooted into the host anatomy. Distinguishing vocabulary includes dual organism; shared circulation; merged tissue; secondary rooted structures..

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Symbiote can create a second living system fused into the host through shared circulation, nerve routes, skin exchange, secondary mouths/eyes, appendage roots, membranes or organ-like masses. The secondary organism may be extensive or localized, but its roots and interfaces must visibly alter host anatomy: ribs may open to house it, skin may form shared boundaries, limbs may share musculature, or hair may become a host/symbiote transition system. Neither component is a removable suit.

**Materialization modes.** dual-organism tissue; shared circulation; merged skin boundaries; secondary rooted appendages; paired sensory systems; host-symbiote organ interfaces; exchange membranes; interdependent support.

**Body-regime range.** Supports subtle localized symbiosis, elegant dual-surface bodies, asymmetrical host-heavy forms, compact paired-organism designs and extreme bodies where both organisms co-author most anatomy.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may define either organism's material, morphology or topology, alter the interface between them or change which systems are shared. Symbiote reciprocally forces partner concepts into interdependent dual-body relationships rather than simple overlay or possession.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
striking, predatory, alien, protective or disturbing female identities with strong asymmetry and material-boundary potential.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must accommodate both organisms' actual roots and exchange regions while keeping clothing physically separate from living symbiote tissue. Critical host-symbiote boundaries should remain visible.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Symbiote may influence weapons through paired materials, dual-channel internals, cooperative grip/interface structures or interlocking secondary geometry while the weapon remains separate from both living bodies.

#### Interpretation boundary
Living armor, a removable suit, painted tendrils or an external companion do not constitute Symbiote; two biological systems must physically co-author one character body.

Female body fused with multiple powerful lower-body predator extensions organized around one central torso. Distinguishing vocabulary includes multi-predator lower body; redistributed pelvis; rooted neck/jaw extensions; central female torso..

**Body-system possibilities.** Scylla can redistribute the pelvis and lower torso into a multi-root support platform carrying several predator necks, jaws, serpentine extensions or tail-like bodies around one dominant female torso. Partners may replace the predator morphology, alter extension count/material, merge or split roots, change radial organization or transform the central support platform. Monstrous, majestic, predatory, striking or overwhelming female identities with exceptional lower-body silhouette variety.

**BROAD CATEGORY 5.5 — SUPERNATURAL BEING**

### SC002 — Angel
**Broad category:** Supernatural Being  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Angel is a supernatural humanoid whose mandatory visual vocabulary is humanlike personhood combined with angelic wing architecture and a **floating aureole disc/ring**. The aureole is an intrinsic character-owned canonical structure even when spatially detached from the head; it is not an aura, glow cloud, or environmental effect. The concept is body-first here: no cathedral, prayer pose, harp, clouds, white dress, or moral “purity” is implied unless separately supplied. Distinguishing vocabulary includes clear angelic wing architecture; mandatory bounded floating aureole disc/ring morphology; humanlike supernatural body; feather or radiant constituent structures integrated into anatomy. radial or hierarchical symmetry; luminous eye structure; feathered hair/skin transitions; ordered appendage tiers. multiple wing sets; full-body mandorla structures.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** - **Face / hair:** feather growth can begin at temple, nape or crown and merge into hair groups; the aureole may remain spatially detached but must keep a stable cranial/cervical positional relationship and participate in the same material/colour/symbiosis logic as the body; eyes may carry radial iris construction.
- **Torso:** wing support can visibly reshape scapulae, ribs and waist; feather plates can follow breastbone/clavicle planes while remaining intrinsic anatomy.
- **Limbs:** fingers can carry feather-fringe or ray structures; lower legs may remain human or take light avian influence without turning Angel into Harpy.
- **Appendages:** wing count, root and articulation vary widely; the mandatory aureole disc/ring frames the head/body axis with fixed character ownership; additional ring systems may frame shoulders, torso or hips when physically justified.
- **Substrate:** human skin, feather fields, luminous tissue and translucent membranes may coexist in deliberate large zones.

- **Face:** luminous sclera/iris rings; feathered temple planes; delicate radial markings that are material transitions, not makeup; high transformation may add secondary bounded eye structures around crown while preserving the main female face.
- **Hair:** feather-to-hair gradients, white is not mandatory; hair may form plume groups, glass/silk feather analogues, or ring-framed masses.
- **Neck / shoulders / chest:** cervical winglets; feathered clavicular fans; sternum-centered radiant channels; major dorsal wing support running into ribs and waist.
- **Torso / hips:** mandorla-like body rims anchored through ribs/pelvis; feather panels that open from the body as intrinsic anatomy rather than separate layers; hip winglets can counterbalance large upper wings.
- **Hands / feet:** feather-fringed fingers, ray-like nails, or subtly altered foot structure; avoid Harpy-like talons unless the active fusion specifically justifies them.
- **Appendages:** dorsal, flank, cranial or arm-integrated wings; rings/discs with fixed anchors; multiple wing scales from tiny face-framing fins to enormous back masses.
- **Substrate:** skin + feather; translucent luminous tissue; metallic or mineral feather analogues when fused; internal light channels bounded by anatomy.
- **Topology:** perforated wings, ring-through-body continuity, paired openings framed by feather roots, or split wing surfaces that reconnect through Portal-like adjacency.
- **Fully human:** elegant human female character whose eye/skin/hair architecture contains feather/radial anatomy and whose small wing/aureole structures visibly root into skull/shoulders.
- **Extreme:** multiple wing systems, luminous/translucent body zones and radial detached morphology can dominate the silhouette while female face, torso axis, waist/hip relation and deliberate hair/hair-analogue remain clear.

**Materialization modes.** Feather vanes and shafts; wing bones/rays; bounded rings/discs; luminous or light-permeable body matter; radial anchors; layered feather roots; membrane; hollow/lightweight support; body-bound aureole elements.

**Body-regime range.** - **Fully human:** human female character with structurally integrated feathered cranial/shoulder zones, radiant eye anatomy and a small floating aureole disc/ring held in a stable character-owned relation to the head/body axis.
- **Human-dominant:** large wings and the mandatory aureole system jointly reshape visual hierarchy while face and limbs remain largely human.
- **Hybrid:** feather substrate, multiple wing roots, altered eyes and radial body structures spread across torso and limbs.
- **High:** wings may partially replace arms or form multiple dorsal/flank systems; body matter can become luminous/feathered while feminine torso and face remain primary.
- **Maximum female-preserving:** a radically winged/radial female character with much of the body reorganized into feather/ray/ring anatomy, but not a floating symbol cluster or bird body with a female character head. Useful distinct routes include **Face-framed seraphic:** small cranial/neck wings and complex aureole architecture make the face the dominant luxury focal point. **Cathedral-scale silhouette without architecture:** enormous ordered wings emerging from anatomically reworked back/ribs; torso remains clean and elegant. **Luminous translucent angel:** sparse feathers, more light-permeable membranes and internal radiant channels; strong with Glass, Ice or Water. **Feather-body heroine:** feather substrate climbs from limbs into torso and hair while face retains soft skin and deliberate beauty contrast. **Radical radial angel:** multiple wing or ring systems organize around head, chest and hips with a clear hierarchy and female central axis.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Angel tends to impose **ordered roots, radial framing and lift-oriented appendage geometry** on partners. Materials can replace feathers or aureole matter, but must inherit feather layering, ring continuity or wing support. Creature partners should alter wing, cranial and distal anatomy rather than simply add horns or tails. Phenomena often work through bounded emission/transmission channels inside feathers, rings or eyes. Spatial tools are powerful when they re-route wing surfaces or aureole continuity. Shallow fusion occurs when the partner only recolors wings or floats around the character. Partners may replace, redistribute, segment, hollow, soften, rigidify, multiply, merge, reroute or rescale the relevant Feather vanes and shafts; wing bones/rays; bounded rings/discs; luminous or light-permeable body matter; radial anchors according to their own mechanics, while Angel reciprocally preserves its distinguishing structural logic inside the shared body.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Angel has unusually strong premium-character range because wings, feathers, aureoles, luminous eyes and ordered radial structures can all become **anatomy**, not accessories. It supports beautiful face framing, enormous silhouette variation, delicate through monumental body regimes, and high transformation while remaining character-first.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfit architecture must be designed around the resolved Angel body, especially clear angelic wing architecture; the mandatory floating aureole disc/ring; humanlike supernatural body; feather or radiant constituent structures integrated into anatomy; and radial or hierarchical symmetry. Garment openings, edges, layers and attachments may echo or counter these intrinsic systems while preserving their true roots, body ownership and silhouette.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
After a weapon category is selected for the frozen character, Angel may influence proportion, internal geometry, material transitions, negative space, grip/interface or secondary structure through Feather vanes and shafts; wing bones/rays; bounded rings/discs; luminous or light-permeable body matter. The conventional weapon macro remains immediately readable.

#### Interpretation boundary
- White dress + wings as costume shorthand.
- Aureole reduced to an unowned decorative symbol rather than a persistent character-owned canonical structure.
- Wings attached to an unchanged back without support consequences.
- Importing purity, church architecture, prayer, harps or clouds as default associations.
- Turning the character into a bird/Harpy; Angel's supernatural human axis must remain distinct.

Outfit architecture must be designed around the resolved Seraphim body, especially Three anatomically differentiated wing pairs; Strong radial or vertical wing hierarchy around a female core; Dense feather-root systems across scapula, ribs, pelvis, or cranial structures; Mandatory floating aureole disc/ring retained as an angelic family anchor, while the six-wing system remains the Seraphim-specific distinction. ### SC005 — Elf
**Broad category:** Supernatural Being  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Elf is a humanlike supernatural/fantasy people concept whose most stable visual anchor in modern character design is an **elongated pointed ear architecture**, accompanied by refined humanlike proportions and the possibility of subtly nonhuman cranial, ocular and sensory morphology. It does not require forest clothing, bows, leaves, nobility, magic effects or a particular ethnicity/skin tone. Distinguishing vocabulary includes distinctly elongated pointed ears integrated into the skull; humanlike supernatural face/body. refined or elongated cranial lines; unusual ear root/helix complexity; large/clear sensory eyes; long neck or limb rhythm where chosen. branching ear tips; translucent/thin ear tissue; elongated canines; subtly nonhuman hand/finger proportions.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** - **Face / skull:** ear roots can sit high, low, posterior, sweeping backward, upward, or laterally; the temporal skull and cheek/hairline must respond to that placement.
- **Eyes:** can be wide and luminous, narrow and severe, horizontally elongated, or subtly angular; no single generic “elf face.”
- **Hair:** side locks, braids, blunt bobs, shaved sides, heavy volume or short crops can all be designed around ear exposure/occlusion; ears may pierce through hair masses only if hair actually parts around them.
- **Proportion:** petite, tall, muscular, curvy, slender or compact elves are all valid; choose a deliberate head/neck/limb rhythm rather than automatic tall-thin stereotypes.
- **Hands / distal:** long fingers, fine nails or subtly extended joints can reinforce an elegant sensory species identity without becoming monster claws.

- **Skull / ear root:** high roots can widen the upper head; low posterior roots lengthen the skull; heavy roots can subtly change cheek/temple planes.
- **Eyes:** broad luminous irises, narrow long lids, crystalline or partner-material pupils; eye design should complement ear direction rather than repeat one “elf eye.”
- **Hair:** precise channels around ears, ear-emphasizing bobs, enormous posterior volume countering lateral ears, braids threading between roots, or short crops exposing cartilage.
- **Neck / shoulders:** long neck is optional; compact neck with strong shoulders can create a very different premium elf. Small sensory fins may extend to neck only when concept/fusion supports them.
- **Hands:** fine elongated fingers, narrow joints, unusual nail material; fully human hand structure can still be distinctive.
- **Surface:** ear translucency, subtle cartilage striations, partner-material edge gradients, or vein/channel systems can create internal detail.
- **Topology:** ear perforations, split cartilage bridges, layered helix cavities or partner-driven openings; avoid jewelry-like holes as sole carrier.
- **Proportion:** petite, tall, broad, muscular, full-figured and androgynously elegant regimes are all available; ears and head/body ratio must propagate coherently.
- **Fully human:** ears + skull/hair/eyes/hands materially authored, with ordinary skin and human limbs.
- **Extreme:** large finned/forked ears, more elongated cranial/sensory anatomy and nonhuman proportions; face remains an authored female humanoid, not a generic fae monster.

**Materialization modes.** Extended auricular cartilage; altered temporal skull/ear-root geometry; thin/translucent ear tissue; long clean facial lines; variable limb/neck proportions; fine distal digits; optional sensory ridges/veins in ears.

**Body-regime range.** - **Fully human:** normal human body with real elongated ear cartilage rooted into altered temple/hairline geometry plus distinctive nonhuman eye/hand proportions.
- **Human-dominant:** more extreme ear shapes, skull elongation, thin translucent ear material and altered limb rhythm.
- **Hybrid:** sensory anatomy spreads—ear structures, eyes, fingers and cranial ridges become more nonhuman while face remains clearly female and humanlike.
- **High:** ears may branch, fold or carry partner material; head/neck and proportions become distinctly nonhuman, yet remain an elf female character rather than generic fae creature.
- **Maximum:** radical auricular/cranial silhouette, elongated sensory structures and partner-driven body changes while preserving humanoid female body architecture. Useful distinct routes include **Ear-silhouette beauty:** unusually long lateral/back-swept ears become the main head hook, balanced by clean hair masses. **Compact sharp elf:** petite or athletic body, short angular ears, strong eyes and cropped hair—distinct from tall ethereal defaults. **Statuesque sensory elf:** long neck/limbs and thin translucent ear tissue create elegant vertical rhythm. **Ear-architecture experimental:** forked, finned or layered ear cartilage remains recognizably elven but supports material/topology fusions. **Human-passing elf:** subtle ears partly hidden by hair, but skull/eye/hand proportions keep the concept materially present.

- **Limbs:** long fine fingers/toes, delicate joints, membrane fins or insectlike distal segmentation can carry the concept.

### SC584 — Rusalka

### SC698 — Ophanim
**Broad category:** Supernatural Being  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Ophanim is a distinct angelic identity organized through nested or intersecting eye-bearing wheels. Wheels, their crossing relationships and distributed eyes are intrinsic anatomical systems with meaningful topology. This leaf is not a decorative halo variant of Angel, nor Seraphim's six-wing body, nor Cherubim's multidirectional wing/face organization.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Interlocking wheel structures can define cranial, thoracic, pelvic or full-body topology with continuous rims, differentiated inner/outer surfaces and explicit intersection or nesting relationships. Eyes emerge as integrated sensory organs along wheel tissue and maintain local depth, orientation and attachment. A female face can occupy a central axial structure or a coherently integrated wheel junction; the eyes, hair and surrounding masses must remain deliberately authored identity systems. Scalp-rooted hair may form radial or curved groups that respond to the wheel geometry. Body-owned spatially detached wheels are valid only when they satisfy the runtime's intrinsic ownership test; connected hubs and rims provide another route. Material transitions and colour distinguish load-bearing rims, sensory bands and central anatomy.

**Materialization modes.** Nested eye-bearing wheel; intersecting rim topology; distributed sensory band; axial hub; radial tissue continuity; body-owned detached wheel; differentiated rim depth.

**Body-regime range.** Compact wheel-framed, elongated axial, broad intersecting-ring and radical wheel-organized female bodies are valid. Wheel topology remains mandatory even when the face and central body are highly human-readable.

#### Symbiosis affordances
A partner can transform wheel substrate, the nature of intersections, sensory tissue or hub support. Ophanim reciprocally forces that partner into cyclic continuity and distributed sensory orientation. Shared rims must change how the partner can bear mass, connect or perceive; simply circling an unchanged partner with ornamental rings fails. Complete-set dependency for larger concept sets must arise in the actual shared construction.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Precise rim spacing, restrained eye hierarchy, elegant intersections and a strong attractive primary face can make unusual angelic anatomy premium and legible without turning every eye into an equally loud focal point.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits require real attachment and clearance around wheel paths and central junctions. They cannot supply the wheels or obscure their intrinsic relationship to the character.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
A conventional weapon can use intersecting annular guards, eye-bearing material bands or hub/rim construction while retaining the selected category and a clear physical load path.

#### Interpretation boundary
Decorative aureoles, floating eye props and generic angel wings do not satisfy Ophanim. Wheel topology and integrated eyes are mandatory; Angel and Seraphim anchors are not inherited merely because all share Angelic ancestry.

### SC701 — Huldra
**Broad category:** Supernatural Being  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Huldra is a beautiful humanoid supernatural being from Scandinavian folk traditions, distinguished by concealed rear-body otherness, especially a tail and, in some accounts, a hollow back. The selected source tradition governs the exact rear morphology. For this entry, the documented Norwegian route retains a tail; a hollow-back route additionally retains a genuine rear cavity. A flat tree texture or general forest beauty does not establish Huldra.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** The body begins with a deliberately attractive female face and coherent humanoid proportions, while the posterior axis develops its selected canonical tail and rear-body construction. A tail has an actual sacral root, continuous tissue and appropriate taper; its native form follows the chosen tradition. Where a hollow back is selected, the cavity has a defined rim, depth and living outer structure integrated with spine, ribs and pelvic support. Its internal material must belong to the body. Hair can have strong rooted masses or braided organization that reveals the authored rear transition. The reference must make the tail and any required hollow-back relationship analytically readable without a narrative reveal.

**Materialization modes.** Tradition-specific tail; sacral continuity; hollow posterior cavity where selected; rear rim and support; beautiful humanoid face; living inner/outer transition; rooted hair hierarchy.

**Body-regime range.** Petite, tall elegant, full-bodied and radically hollow-backed humanoid female forms are valid. Human readability does not erase the selected tail or cavity anchors. Freeze the tradition-derived route before materialization; do not trade anchors away mid-design.

#### Symbiosis affordances
A partner can transform the tail substrate, cavity topology or the transition between humanlike living tissue and supernatural posterior construction. Huldra reciprocally gives that partner a rear-facing structural dependence and a tension between refined frontal identity and altered back anatomy. The shared support must need both concepts; a generic forest-themed female character with a separate tail ornament fails.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Beauty is central to this identity: strong facial authorship, sophisticated proportions and an elegant rear silhouette should remain premium even when the cavity is physically unusual. The contrast is anatomical, not a story about interpersonal allure.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits accommodate the actual sacral tail root and any hollow-back rim, preserving their structural legibility through deliberate tailoring rather than supplying those features.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
A conventional weapon may echo a continuous tail-like load path, a hollow-backed section or a living rim/core relationship without becoming a forest prop.

#### Interpretation boundary
Generic Dryad, tree-patterned skin, a folklore costume or a narrative claim of supernatural allure is insufficient. Do not universalize every regional attribute: use a documented route, preserve its rear-body anchors and distinguish Huldra from generic nature spirits.

### SC039 — Salt
**Broad category:** Mineral / Gemstone  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Saline mineral identity defined by cubic sodium-chloride growth, granular packing, crust/deposit formation, dissolution and recrystallization. Salt is not generic “crystal”: its strongest distinguishing vocabulary is cubic/stepped growth, grains, efflorescent crusts, porous deposits, brittle cleavage and precipitation from fluid.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Salt can literally constitute skin, internal support, limbs, hair, nails, ribs, joint collars or appendages; precipitate along channels and cavity rims; create saline ribs or struts that emerge from and re-enter the torso; grow cubic appendices from skull, spine, shoulders, hips or limbs; form granular distal anatomy; or dissolve away selected body volume and recrystallize at neighboring boundaries. Dense compact salt, loose grains, porous crust and transparent/opaque cubic masses can coexist as different states of the same body. Salt can also line apertures or bridge them with brittle crystalline spans when the final design requires it.

**Materialization modes.** cubic crystal growth; granular beds; efflorescent crust; precipitated veins; saline ribs/struts; cavity lining; dissolution channels; recrystallized bridges; compact translucent salt; brittle stepped appendages.

**Body-regime range.** Supports fully human-compatible bodies with selective saline systems, petite or broad mineralized bodies, soft flesh/salt contrasts, elongated crystalline routes and near-total saline constitutions. No physique is intrinsic to Salt.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may determine Salt’s growth path, packing density, crystal scale, colour, continuity, load direction, dissolution pattern, state distribution, topology or anatomical location. Salt can in turn constitute, line, infill, precipitate within, bridge, encrust, reinforce, embrittle, dehydrate, fracture, dissolve from or recrystallize through partner structures. These broad roles let it enter shared systems rather than sit on top of them.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
From delicate translucent saline filaments to powerful crusted ribs or extreme granular/mineral bodies, Salt can create clean, strange and highly distinctive female silhouettes without defaulting to generic gemstone anatomy.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must follow real saline protrusions, fragile crusts, apertures and granular zones; garment edges should avoid turning salt body matter into removable decorative plating.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may use cubic insets, precipitated seams, brittle salt-like internal structures or granular-to-compact material transitions after a clear category is established.

#### Interpretation boundary
A white palette, salt dust, detached crystals or an armor-like salt coating over an unchanged body are weak interpretations. Salt must participate in anatomy, substrate, internal structure, topology or body-grown morphology.

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Banded chalcedony identity defined by dense fine-grained stone with parallel or gently layered black/white/earth-toned bands and polished depth. Onyx differs from Obsidian through banding and microcrystalline stone character, and from Agate through more regular, often parallel layering.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Onyx can make torso, limbs or hair into dense polished bodies crossed by broad layered bands that wrap or slice through anatomy. Cut edges or apertures can reveal stacked strata; joints can align to band boundaries; the face may carry controlled band transitions through temples, jaw or ocular surrounds. Hair can become polished layered ribbons rather than glassy flakes.

**Materialization modes.** parallel banding; polished opaque/translucent chalcedony; layered cross-sections; dense smooth stone; black/white strata; band-controlled joints; cut layered rims; ribbon-like banded hair.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite graphic bodies, slender elegant forms, curvy layered physiques, broad sculptural masses and high-transformation banded stone bodies.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may bend, interrupt, perforate, colour or thicken the bands. Onyx reciprocally organizes partner matter into disciplined parallel strata and polished dense body masses rather than generic black mineral.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Graphic, luxurious, severe or sophisticated female identities with very strong value-pattern architecture.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits should avoid covering the major body banding and can use simple contrasting materials to preserve its graphic read.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may use parallel layered material, polished dark sections and cross-sectional band reveals while maintaining simple macro geometry.

#### Interpretation boundary
Black stone, glossy surfaces or random bands alone are insufficient. Onyx needs dense chalcedony-like material with deliberate layered band structure.

### SC072 — Stone
**Broad category:** Mineral / Gemstone  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Broad rock-material identity defined by heavy mineral mass, granular or stratified internal structure, erosion, fissure and blunt load-bearing behavior. Stone is intentionally more general than Marble, Obsidian, Jade or crystalline minerals: it represents rock as structural body matter rather than a specific mineral habit.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Stone can form massive ribs, limbs, cranial blocks, hands/feet, torso cores, external buttresses or internal struts; expose granular broken interiors; split along fissures; stack into stratified body layers; or erode into rounded and pitted forms. It can be coarse, smooth, sedimentary-looking, igneous-looking or metamorphic-looking so long as it does not collapse into a more specific named mineral concept already selected.

**Materialization modes.** heavy rock mass; granular interiors; strata; fissures; blunt load-bearing blocks; eroded surfaces; pitted stone; stacked layers; massive body struts; broken rock cross-sections.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite dense bodies, broad monumental forms, soft-flesh/stone hybrids, athletic rocky anatomy, statuesque monoliths and extreme rock bodies.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may determine rock composition, erosion, layering, cavities, inclusions, growth or shape. Stone reciprocally gives partner structures heavy mineral mass, blunt support, fissuring and stratification without forcing crystalline faceting.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Powerful, ancient-looking, monumental, grounded or sculptural female identities with broad mass potential.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must fit the actual rock contours, protrusions and fissures, with clear separation from wearable hard components.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may use stone mass, layered rock, pitted surfaces or heavy simple forms where category-appropriate.

#### Interpretation boundary
Generic grey colouring or faceted gemstone growth is not Stone. It should behave as rock: massive, granular/stratified, fissured and load-bearing.

Outfits must attach to glass anatomy without hiding critical transparent regions and should preserve clear distinction between body glass and wearable transparent material.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may use transparent blades/shafts, hollow glass cores, lenses or stress-pattern details while preserving category readability and structural plausibility.

#### Interpretation boundary
Faceted crystals, gemstone spikes or simple transparency are not enough. Glass should behave as smooth amorphous material with thickness, refraction, hollow forms and fracture logic.

### SC047 — Porcelain
**Broad category:** Material / Substance  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Fired-ceramic identity defined by smooth pale dense body, thin-wall translucency, glazed or matte surfaces, brittle clean fracture and fine crazing. Porcelain differs from Stone/Marble through its refined ceramic shell behavior and thin hollow potential.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Porcelain can form smooth face/torso shells, hollow limbs, thin rib plates, articulated ceramic finger segments, sculpted cranial forms or hair ribbons made from thin fired laminae. Joints can use nested ceramic shells around softer partner material; broken edges reveal dense pale ceramic thickness; crazing can trace stress zones. Translucent thin sections can appear at ears, fingertips or fine appendages.

**Materialization modes.** smooth fired ceramic; pale dense body; thin-wall translucency; hollow shells; fine crazing; clean brittle fracture; glazed/matte contrast; sculpted ceramic laminae.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite doll-like-but-protagonist-grade bodies, soft sculptural forms, slender hollow-shell bodies, broad ceramic masses and high-transformation porcelain anatomies.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may fill hollow shells, stain, crack, reinforce, glaze, perforate or grow through Porcelain. Porcelain reciprocally gives partner systems refined fired-ceramic shells, smooth sculptural surfaces and brittle thin-wall structure.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Elegant, uncanny, luxurious, pristine or gothic female identities with strong face and surface appeal.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must remain separate from porcelain body shells and accommodate brittle edges, hollow regions and protrusions.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may use porcelain ceramic sections, glazed insets or hollow rigid structures where appropriate without becoming decorative tableware.

#### Interpretation boundary
White smooth skin, doll styling or stone-like mass alone is insufficient. Porcelain requires fired-ceramic shell behavior, thin translucency and brittle refined surfaces.

### SC073 — Paper

Fibrous sheet-material identity defined by thin planes, folds, creases, tears, lamination, rolled tubes, pleats and pulp/fibre structure. Paper differs from fabric by retaining sheet memory and crease-defined geometry.

**Body-system possibilities.** Paper can form laminated torso shells, folded ribs, rolled bone-like cores, pleated waist structures, crease-jointed limbs, sheet hair, curled cranial forms or cut apertures bounded by thickened laminated edges. Thick pulp can form soft rounded cores while outer sheets create crisp folds. Tears can expose fibres and inner layers; accordion structures can change volume while remaining intrinsic anatomy.

**Materialization modes.** sheets; folds; creases; lamination; rolled tubes; pleats; torn fibres; cut windows; pulp cores; accordion structures; curled edges.

Graphic, elegant, delicate, uncanny or architectural female identities with powerful line and fold silhouettes.

Outfits must be visibly separate from intrinsic paper anatomy even when they use similar material; body folds and garment folds need clear ownership.

Weapons may use laminated paper composites, rolled cores, folded surfaces or cut negative space while retaining conventional macro construction.

#### Interpretation boundary
Paper clothing, printed motifs or flat white surfaces are insufficient. Paper must physically construct anatomy through sheets, folds, fibres and lamination.

### SC074 — Wood
**Broad category:** Material / Substance  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Lignified plant-material identity defined by directional grain, growth rings, knots, branching, fibrous fracture and rigid-to-flexible structural members. Wood is not generic plant growth: it is the structural material itself and its growth history.

**Body-system possibilities.** Wood can form grain-aligned limbs, ringed joint cross-sections, branching ribs, knotted cranial masses, root-like hands/feet, hollow trunk-like torso channels or hair built from fine wooden fibres and branchlets. Heartwood/sapwood contrast can organize internal layers; split grain can shape claws or appendages; growth rings can reveal material growth history within the wood substrate. Bark may appear selectively as an outer body layer while exposed wood remains structural.

**Materialization modes.** directional grain; growth rings; knots; branching supports; fibrous splits; heartwood/sapwood zoning; root-like joints; hollow wooden tubes; bark-to-wood transitions.

Organic, elegant, powerful, ancient-looking or feral female identities with strong branching and material warmth.

Outfits must accommodate actual branches, knots, bark transitions and wood anatomy, remaining distinct even if made from natural materials.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution

### SC216 — Mosaic
**Broad category:** Material / Substance  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Constructed material identity in which one continuous body is assembled from many discrete tessera-like pieces whose edges, orientation and joins remain visible and structurally meaningful. Mosaic is piecewise continuity, not a printed tile pattern.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Mosaic can divide face, torso, limbs, hair or appendages into thousands of bounded tesserae; use larger pieces at load-bearing regions and smaller pieces around joints; create articulated tile scales; line apertures with edge-rich piece boundaries; or build cavities whose interiors use a different tessera orientation. Pieces may be stone, glass, metal, ceramic or partner-defined matter, but the body remains one integrated anatomy through deliberate join networks and support paths.

**Materialization modes.** tessellated body substrate; visible joins; piece-size hierarchy; articulated tile fields; edge-rich apertures; multi-material tesserae; joint-specific tiling; piecewise hair/cranial masses; assembled continuity.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite intricate bodies, soft silhouettes built from tiny tesserae, athletic articulated tile systems, broad large-piece physiques and extreme piecewise bodies.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners can determine tessera material, shape, colour, transparency, topology or join behavior. Mosaic reciprocally discretizes partner matter into coordinated pieces while preserving overall anatomical continuity and allowing local reorientation around joints or apertures.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Graphic, luxurious, uncanny, technological or sacred-looking female identities with strong surface and topology control.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must remain clearly removable over the tessellated anatomy and cannot simply continue the same join network without ownership cues.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may use tessellated material fields, piecewise grips/guards or multi-material insets while preserving a simple recognizable macro.

#### Interpretation boundary
Printed tile patterns, decorative mosaics or external plating over an unchanged body are insufficient. The tesserae must actually constitute or structurally organize the body.

### SC060 — Bone

Mineralized biological support material defined by dense cortical shells, porous trabecular interiors, marrow-like cavities, joint surfaces, ribs, spines and load-bearing struts. Bone is a material concept; Skeleton is the organized whole-body framework.

**Body-system possibilities.** Bone can replace or externalize selected ribs, limbs, cranial planes, fingers, horns or appendages; create cortical struts around open cavities; expose trabecular interiors at cut or eroded regions; form dense joint collars; grow body-rooted spines or loops; or create hollow lightweight tubes. Soft tissue may remain between bone frames, or large body regions may themselves become bone substrate. Hair analogues can use fine articulated bone filaments or platelets when coherent.

Partners may mineralize, fill, line, replace, soften, hollow or grow through Bone. Bone reciprocally provides biological load-bearing structure, porous interiors, articulation and cavity framing without forcing the full organized Skeleton concept.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Elegant, macabre, powerful, alien or ceremonial female identities with strong structural and negative-space potential.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must preserve identity-critical bone protrusions, apertures and joint structures and cannot convert intrinsic bone into removable armor.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may use bone material, porous cores, cortical edges or articulated struts where structurally coherent while remaining separate from the body.

#### Interpretation boundary
Bone-coloured spikes or a full generic skeleton are insufficient. Bone must behave as mineralized biological material with cortical, porous and joint-specific structure.

### SC062 — Blood
**Broad category:** Material / Substance  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Biological-fluid identity defined by red fluid matter, vascular channels, capillary networks, clotting/coagulation and bounded reservoirs. Blood is not gore: its design value comes from circulation, fluid pressure, clot-to-liquid state change and membrane-contained internal architecture.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Blood can form visible vessel networks beneath translucent body regions, replace selected hair or limbs with membrane-contained red fluid, create vascular ribs and branching channels, fill transparent cavities, thicken into clot-like structural masses at joints or wounds-like seams, or form thin body-bound films over support structures. Coagulation can turn fluid into semi-solid plugs, cords or crusts; pressure can enlarge or constrict reservoirs. Eyes may contain layered vascular structures without requiring injury imagery.

Partners may contain, freeze, crystallize, absorb, channel, clot, colour, heat or replace Blood. Blood reciprocally circulates through partner structures, fills cavities, branches into vascular networks and converts between fluid and coagulated states.

striking, sinister, biological, elegant or monstrous female identities with powerful internal red-line and transparency contrast.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must preserve important vascular/aperture structures and attach to stable anatomy rather than becoming the container that defines the Blood body.

Weapons may use contained blood channels, clot-like insets or vascular branching as internal material systems after the weapon category is established.

Gore, splashes, red colouring or external blood effects are not Blood materialization. The blood must be body-owned fluid, vascular structure, reservoir or coagulated anatomical matter.

### SC080 — Feather
**Broad category:** Material / Substance  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY

A keratinous branched structure built from a central shaft, barbs and vane. Feather is defined by lightweight directional layering, tapered support and soft-to-rigid fiber hierarchy; it is not synonymous with Bird or Wing.

**Body-system possibilities.** Feather may replace hair with rooted quill-and-vane masses, build layered skin or torso surfaces from contour-feather fields, form rib-like or limb-support struts from enlarged shafts, create body-rooted fans, crests, fins or appendices, or produce soft down-like transition zones around harder anatomy. Large feathers may become genuine load-bearing body structures; small feathers may organize joints, facial framing, hands, feet or surface transitions. Vane separation can create controlled openwork and directional silhouette without requiring a literal wing.

Partners may replace keratin, stiffen or soften shafts, occupy vane gaps, alter barb organization, enlarge feather scale, redirect overlap or change rooted attachment. Feather reciprocally introduces taper, overlap, lightweight support, branching fiber structure and directional layered surfaces into partner systems.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Elegant, predatory, ethereal, soft, regal or highly graphic female identities with strong silhouette rhythm and rich hard/soft transitions.

Outfits should preserve major rooted feather systems and use openings, seams or layered boundaries that follow their direction rather than hiding them. Clothing may echo overlap or taper while remaining clearly separate from the intrinsic feathers.

After a conventional weapon macro is chosen, Feather can influence tapered edges, layered vanes/plates, quill-like spines, lightweight internal struts or directional microstructure without turning the weapon into a decorative feather prop.

Loose feathers, a feather boa, feather-print patterning or default bird wings do not constitute Feather body materialization.

striking, alien, cute, uncanny, luxurious or monstrous female identities with exceptional transparency and soft-topology potential.

### SC694 — Ferrofluid
**Broad category:** Material / Substance  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Ferrofluid is a coherent magnetically responsive liquid substrate whose suspended magnetic particles allow applied fields to organize its surface into peaks, ridges and patterned menisci. Its identity joins fluid continuity with field-dependent form. It differs from Mercury's liquid-metal cohesion and reflective mass: magnetically organized liquid structure is necessary here.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Continuous fluid body volumes can rise into disciplined peak arrays around intrinsic magnetic or field-coupled structural regions. Ridges must merge back into the same liquid substrate through menisci and smooth troughs, with changing spacing that communicates a coherent organizing field. The face may hold stable liquid planes around dense eye structures; hair can be bundles of continuous tapered fluid ridges connected to a scalp reservoir. Joint and support regions should explain how the material maintains the certified body form. Intrinsic dark gloss or partner-derived colour follows fluid depth and particle concentration. Field architecture is evidenced by body geometry and bounded internal structures.

**Materialization modes.** Coherent magnetic liquid; field-organized peaks; continuous ridge field; meniscus transition; particle-rich core; fluid reservoir; stable field-coupled support.

**Body-regime range.** Compact dense, long smooth, broad spiked-volume and radical continuous-fluid female bodies are possible. Greater human readability refines liquid facial planes and silhouette without removing the magnetically patterned substrate.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may supply magnetic organization, particle material, viscosity or containers that become integral anatomy. Ferrofluid reciprocally changes the partner's load paths and surfaces into field-dependent liquid continuities. With a rigid partner, peak roots and solid boundaries must transform each other; a separate fluid ornament beside an unchanged solid body does not establish symbiosis.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
An authored rhythm of calm reflective planes and sharply controlled peaks can preserve a beautiful face, expressive eyes and a readable silhouette while making the liquid body's support unusual.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits require a defined physical interface with fluid surfaces and stable support zones. Textile pieces cannot function as an unexplained replacement body or conceal an unresolved fluid regime.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
A conventional weapon may use a magnetically structured fluid insert, integrated reservoir, continuous ridge edge or field-coupled joint with positively specified stable geometry.

#### Interpretation boundary
Black liquid, metallic gloss or arbitrary spikes are insufficient. The continuous liquid and magnetic organization must be jointly legible. External field diagrams or emitted particles are not substitutes for intrinsic construction.

A low-density aerosol of tiny water droplets defined by diffuse translucency, soft density gradients, layered veiling and partial internal obscuration. Fog differs from Smoke through droplet composition and cleaner, wetter diffusion.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Fog may constitute semi-transparent limbs, hair, torso zones or internal cavities whose boundaries remain soft but body-owned. Denser droplet regions can form structural-looking masses while thin zones reveal deeper anatomy. Condensation may bead onto embedded solid structures or concentrate at interfaces; multiple density layers can create veiled internal depth. Fog can fill bounded membrane spaces or emerge continuously from denser intrinsic tissue while never becoming an ambient scene.

**Materialization modes.** droplet aerosol matter; diffuse translucent volumes; layered density gradients; condensation beads; veiled anatomy; soft billows; mist-filled cavities; dense-to-thin transitions.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite mist-core bodies, soft ethereal physiques, slender translucent forms, solid-core/fog hybrids and near-total aerosol anatomy.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may condense, freeze, heat, absorb, channel, color or scaffold Fog. Fog reciprocally softens partner boundaries, fills cavities, reduces visual density and creates layered translucency around internal structures.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Ethereal, mysterious, serene, striking or uncanny female identities with subtle depth and soft silhouette.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits should frame rather than obscure mist body regions and use stable anchors where anatomy becomes diffuse.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may contain fog-like translucent chambers or condensed internal volumes as subordinate character-specific material.

#### Interpretation boundary
Background mist, smoky aura or generic translucency is insufficient. Fog must be a body-owned water-droplet aerosol system.

### SC105 — Storm

**Body-system possibilities.** Storm may organize the torso around a pressure-gradient core, create spiral or banded cloud-like body masses, build rotational channels through limbs or hair, form an eye-like low-density cavity, route intrinsic precipitation through body surfaces, or combine dense aerosol regions with electrical and fluid pathways. Large structures may spiral around internal supports while remaining anatomical.

Powerful, majestic, chaotic, ominous or divine female identities with large-scale internal organization.

Outfits should preserve major circulation structures, apertures and density masses, attaching only to stable anatomy rather than containing the storm.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapons may use spiral channels, pressure cavities or layered storm-like internal systems after a clear conventional macro is chosen.

#### Interpretation boundary
Clouds, rain and lightning placed around the character are insufficient. Storm must exist as an intrinsic coupled body system.

### SC115 — Gravity

Mass-dependent attraction translated into compression, convergence, load concentration, curved trajectories, density gradients and redistribution around one or more intrinsic gravitational centers. Gravity is a force-organizing concept rather than a dark-color or floating motif.

**Body-system possibilities.** Gravity can re-author body mass distribution, skeletal support, joint loading, torso depth, limb taper and appendage direction around selected heavy loci. Hair and appendices may permanently arc along gravitational trajectories; cavities can be lens-shaped by surrounding convergence; feet, pelvis or spine may thicken where load concentrates. Multiple centers can create asymmetric or counterweighted anatomy without requiring motion.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite ultra-dense characters, broad grounded bodies, bottom-heavy or center-heavy physiques, elongated stretched forms, asymmetric dual-center bodies and extreme compact-mass constructions.

Partners may define what becomes heavy, light, dense, deformable or orbitally organized. Gravity reciprocally compresses, bends, stretches, gathers, stratifies or redirects partner matter according to mass and position, making it exceptionally adaptable to solids, fluids, organisms, abstractions and topology concepts.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Oppressive, majestic, compact, monumental, elegant or alien female identities with unusual but coherent mass hierarchy.

Clothing must respect the body's actual mass distribution and curved/load-bearing structures; garment weight, hanging direction and anchor placement can respond to the frozen gravitational architecture.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Weapon scale, balance and center of mass can echo the character's gravity logic through weighted heads, curved internal load paths, offset centers or dense cores after the conventional weapon type is fixed.

#### Interpretation boundary
Floating objects, levitation, star-field imagery or generic heaviness do not constitute Gravity. The force must visibly reorganize the character's own mass and structure.

### SC518 — Rainbow
**Broad category:** Physical / Environmental  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Ordered spectral separation produced by refraction and dispersion: coherent wavelength sequence, curved or fanned banding, transparent/refractive carrier structures and possible recombination. Rainbow is optical ordering, not generic multicolor.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Rainbow can create refractive body regions that split incoming/contained light into ordered spectral bands across hair, eyes, skin, appendices, cavities or transparent internal structures. Bands may curve around anatomy, fan through prism-like tissues, form layered laminae, concentrate at edges or recombine after traversing a body-owned optical path. The spectrum can be narrow, partial or distorted by partners while retaining ordered wavelength logic. Structural color can reshape facial focal points, limb segmentation or silhouette when carried by genuine refractive morphology.

**Materialization modes.** ordered spectral band; dispersion fan; refractive lamina; transparent carrier; curved spectrum path; split/recombined wavelength channel; edge spectrum; spectral gradient tied to geometry.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite jewel-like bodies, slender refractive silhouettes, broad translucent forms, soft spectral-layered bodies and extreme optical-substrate characters.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may provide the refractive medium, alter band spacing, block wavelengths, curve the optical path or convert spectral bands into other body systems. Rainbow reciprocally decomposes partner light/color into ordered components and can create hierarchy through controlled spectral distribution.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Radiant, psychedelic, divine, elegant, luxurious or alien female identities with strong color hierarchy that remains structurally grounded.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits may use transparent/refractive materials or openings that reveal frozen spectral body systems; decorative rainbow prints do not add concept value.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Rainbow can influence prism-like internal channels, ordered spectral insets and refractive edge structures after category readability is secured.

#### Interpretation boundary
Random rainbow coloring, gradient hair or multicolored decoration are insufficient. The ordered spectrum must result from body-owned optical structure.

### SC598 — Sound
**Broad category:** Physical / Environmental  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Mechanical wave propagation through matter, expressed through resonant cavities, membranes, standing-wave geometry, wavelength spacing, compression/rarefaction structure and acoustic coupling. Sound differs from Resonance: Sound is the propagating wave system; Resonance is selective amplification at preferred modes.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Sound can create membrane-like body surfaces, resonant chambers in skull/torso/limbs, repeated spacing based on wavelength, ribbed or segmented structures that carry pressure waves, and cavities connected by acoustic channels. Hair or appendices can become tuned flexible filaments; joints may be built as coupling nodes between vibrating regions; internal structures can show alternating compressed and expanded zones; face and throat architecture can include body-owned sound-producing or transmitting morphology without requiring vocal performance.

**Materialization modes.** resonant cavity; vibrating membrane; acoustic channel; wavelength segmentation; standing-wave node/antinode pattern; compression/rarefaction band; tuned filament; coupled chamber.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite tuned-chamber bodies, slender filament-driven forms, broad resonant torsos, athletic membrane/structure hybrids and extreme anatomy organized by wave propagation.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may change propagation speed, damping, wavelength, membrane material, cavity shape or transmission path. Sound reciprocally makes partner matter vibratory, wave-routed, pressure-banded or acoustically coupled and can turn otherwise static structures into linked propagation systems.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Musical, uncanny, elegant, powerful, ritualistic or technological female identities with strong rhythm and internal architecture.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits should preserve resonant openings and flexible membranes; garment materials may damp or transmit vibration only as a response to the frozen body.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Sound can influence resonant hollows, tuned plates, wave-guiding channels and harmonic segmentation while maintaining the selected weapon's conventional silhouette.

#### Interpretation boundary
Music notes, speakers, singing pose or external sound waves are not Phase-1 Sound. The wave mechanics must belong to the character's body.

### SC599 — Mirage
**Broad category:** Physical / Environmental  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Optical displacement caused by graded refraction, translated into apparent shifts, stretched or doubled boundaries, refractive layering and positional ambiguity within one coherent body. Mirage is not Hologram: the underlying body remains physically present while its apparent position is optically displaced.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Mirage can place refractive-gradient tissue in skin, hair, eyes, limbs or appendices so that internal structures appear offset from their true positions. Body edges may split into paired contours where refractive layers bend light; limbs can contain visually displaced cores; facial planes can shift subtly across transparent zones; cavities may appear deeper or laterally displaced; hair strands can refract adjacent anatomy into repeated bands. The actual anatomy remains coherent, but body-owned optical media create controlled misregistration.

**Materialization modes.** refractive gradient; displaced contour; doubled boundary; shifted internal layer; stretched image band; lens-like body zone; apparent depth shift; refractive seam.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite jewel-like optical bodies, slender heat-haze-like forms, broad layered refractive bodies, soft transparent physiques and extreme anatomy with extensive controlled visual displacement.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may provide the refractive medium, define which structures are displaced, increase or reduce transparency, or shape the gradient. Mirage reciprocally shifts, stretches, duplicates or spatially misregisters the appearance of partner systems while leaving their physical continuity intact.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Elusive, alluring, ethereal, surreal or high-tech female identities with memorable optical uncertainty.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Clothing must be designed against the true frozen anatomy while allowing refractive body zones to remain visible; it may be optically affected but cannot become the source of Mirage.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Mirage can influence refractive inserts, displaced internal edges or lens-like regions while the weapon's actual macro remains physically unambiguous.

#### Interpretation boundary
Transparency, duplicate images, heat-haze scenery or Hologram-like projection are insufficient. Mirage requires body-owned refractive displacement of a physically continuous character.

### SC600 — Earthquake
**Broad category:** Physical / Environmental  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Seismic deformation expressed through faulting, locked stress, compression, shear and sudden relative displacement across connected body regions. Earthquake is structural displacement, not generic cracks or rubble.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Earthquake can divide the body into tectonic-like structural blocks joined across fault seams; shoulders, ribs, pelvis or limbs may be laterally offset while remaining mechanically connected; compression zones can buckle or thicken matter; extension zones can widen gaps or thin supports; hair and appendices can follow shifted planes; joints can become shear interfaces; internal structures may show displaced layers that reveal accumulated stress. The character can remain mostly human or become heavily faulted, but every displacement must affect adjacent support.

**Materialization modes.** fault seam; shifted block; shear plane; compression ridge; extensional gap; buckled layer; stress band; offset joint; displaced internal stratum.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite tightly faulted bodies, broad plate-like physiques, athletic shear-organized forms, asymmetrical shifted silhouettes and extreme segmented-but-connected anatomy.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may determine the material that faults, how it fractures, what fills seams or how blocks reconnect. Earthquake reciprocally shears, offsets, compresses, buckles and stress-loads partner structures.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Powerful, brutal, monumental, unstable or sculptural female identities with compelling asymmetry.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Garments must accommodate actual offsets and fault relief; seams and openings can correspond to frozen displacement rather than visually smoothing it away.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Earthquake can influence shifted laminations, stress grooves, compression ridges or offset component alignment after the weapon type is fixed.

#### Interpretation boundary
Crack textures, broken-ground motifs or a shaking pose are not Earthquake. Seismic stress and displacement must physically reorganize the body.

### SC601 — Tsunami
**Broad category:** Physical / Environmental  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
A long-wavelength surge carrying enormous water mass, translated into accumulated fluid volume, steepening/cresting geometry, layered flow and forceful directional redistribution. Tsunami is mass surge rather than an ordinary decorative wave.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Tsunami can load one side or region of the body with a large coherent water mass, create crest-like hair or appendices rooted in dense fluid support, shape torso or hips into broad advancing curves, or build limbs from layered water whose thickness increases toward a leading front. Internal channels can show compressed water pushing into narrower anatomy; appendage roots can widen under the carried mass; body-owned cavities may contain rolling internal layers. The surge can be vertically rising, laterally sweeping or folded through the body as long as its huge mass and directional transfer remain evident.

**Materialization modes.** deep fluid mass; long-wave curve; cresting edge; advancing front; layered surge; compressed water body; heavy fluid shoulder/hip mass; rolling internal sheet.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite bodies with one disproportionate wave mass, soft/full fluid physiques, broad powerful surge bodies, elongated directional forms and near-total water-mass characters.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may freeze, mineralize, electrify, color, contain, perforate or redirect the water mass. Tsunami reciprocally overwhelms, loads, sweeps, layers and redistributes partner systems into a coherent directional surge.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Majestic, catastrophic, striking, powerful or oceanic female identities with unmistakable large-form flow.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must frame or clear the frozen surge masses and fluid appendage roots; wave-themed clothing does not contribute to Phase 1.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Tsunami can influence broad sweeping curvature, heavy fluid cores, layered channels or leading-edge geometry after a conventional weapon category is established.

#### Interpretation boundary
A wave behind the character, blue water texture or flowing pose is not Tsunami. The enormous directional water mass must be part of the body itself.

### SC602 — Radiation

Energetic emission from an intrinsic source, translated through source zones, penetration depth, attenuation, shielding, dose-like gradients and material change along emission paths. Radiation is broader than visible Light and must not depend on glow.

**Body-system possibilities.** Radiation can establish one or more body-owned emission sources in torso, skull, limbs or internal organs and visibly differentiate nearby matter according to penetration and attenuation. Partners may define radiation type, source matter, shielding, absorption, activation or resulting transformation. Radiation reciprocally penetrates, attenuates through, activates, damages or changes partner systems according to distance and material interaction.

Hazardous, divine, alien, technological or uncanny female identities with strong internal hierarchy.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfit materials can selectively shield, reveal or route around existing emission zones, but clothing cannot be the source that makes the concept exist.

### SC603 — Shockwave

A rapidly propagating pressure discontinuity defined by a sharp compression front followed by expansion and displaced matter. Shockwave is a singular force-front architecture, distinct from continuous Sound or ambient Pressure.

**Body-system possibilities.** Shockwave can create sharp concentric or directional bands where anatomy changes abruptly from compressed to expanded state. Torso layers may buckle around a central source; limbs can widen downstream from a front; hair and appendices can be permanently stepped or displaced across wave boundaries; joints may use nested rings or diaphragms that encode one strong pressure transition. Several fronts may intersect if they remain structurally legible rather than becoming decorative ripples.

**Materialization modes.** compression front; expansion wake; concentric band; radial displacement; stepped anatomy; pressure diaphragm; source-centered shell; directional front.

Partners may determine what launches the front, what medium carries it, how quickly it attenuates or how matter deforms across it. Shockwave reciprocally compresses, displaces, separates and radially reorganizes partner systems.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Explosive, powerful, severe, high-impact or futuristic female identities with crisp structural rhythm.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Garment architecture should accommodate major radial bands and displaced anatomy; repeated rings on clothing alone do not carry the concept.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Shockwave can influence compression chambers, concentric component spacing, recoil-like internal structures or abrupt thickness changes while preserving category clarity.

#### Interpretation boundary

### SC604 — Tide
**Broad category:** Physical / Environmental  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Periodic redistribution of a fluid mass between higher and lower states, producing paired rise/fall zones, rhythmic boundaries and recurrent directional transfer. Tide differs from Ocean by its periodic mass shift and from Tsunami by lacking a singular catastrophic surge.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Tide can split the body into regions of raised and lowered fluid mass, create repeated high/low boundaries around torso or limbs, redistribute volume between paired sides or vertical zones, and form crescent-like or basin-like interfaces where water periodically occupies more or less body space. Hair and appendices can show alternating filled/withdrawn segments; cavities may have visible tide lines as genuine material-state boundaries; paired structures can counterbalance one another through transferred fluid mass.

**Materialization modes.** high-water zone; low-water zone; tide-line boundary; periodic paired mass; basin transfer; alternating filled/withdrawn channel; crescent fluid interface; rhythmic redistribution.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite bodies with compact paired reservoirs, soft/full fluid physiques, broad lower-body tide masses, elegant elongated channels and extreme bodies organized around large reciprocal fluid shifts.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may control cycle geometry, fluid type, boundary material, gravitational emphasis or what is exposed as mass recedes. Tide reciprocally redistributes partner matter between paired regions and introduces cyclical spatial hierarchy.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Serene, lunar, striking, balanced, aquatic or uncanny female identities with elegant repeated structure.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Clothing can frame high/low body boundaries and paired reservoirs while preserving the frozen mass-shift architecture.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Tide can influence alternating thick/thin sections, paired reservoirs, repeated rising/falling edge motifs or fluid transfer channels in a readable weapon.

#### Interpretation boundary
Wave motifs, moon symbols or generic water bodies are insufficient. Tide requires intrinsic periodic redistribution between distinguishable body regions.

### SC605 — Quicksand
**Broad category:** Physical / Environmental  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
A water-saturated granular state whose load-bearing behavior can collapse under stress, combining packed sediment, fluidized zones, sinking deformation and unstable support. Quicksand differs from Mud through grain-dominated structure and stress-sensitive loss of support.

#### Phase 1 — Intrinsic body materialization
**Body-system possibilities.** Quicksand can make torso, limbs, joints or appendices from densely packed grains that loosen into fluidized regions under structural load. Joints may appear partially submerged into their own granular sockets; lower-body mass can broaden where grains settle; cavities can be partly filled by mobile sediment; hands or feet may transition from compact surfaces into loose grain fields; internal supports can be visible where fluidization would otherwise collapse anatomy. The body can alternate stable crust-like packing with mobile saturated zones.

**Materialization modes.** saturated grain mass; packed-to-fluid transition; sinking joint; granular socket; settled lower mass; mobile infill; unstable support zone; compacted crust over fluidized grains.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite dense bodies, soft/full settling forms, broad grounded physiques, athletic compact-grain bodies and extreme partially fluidized anatomy.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may bind, freeze, heat, crystallize, root through, drain or reinforce Quicksand. Quicksand reciprocally engulfs, settles around, destabilizes, suspends or partially buries partner structures within the character.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Dangerous, earthy, striking, oppressive or surreal female identities with unusual support and mass behavior.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Garments need stable anchors on the frozen body and must not visually erase sinking joints or granular transitions.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Quicksand can influence packed-grain cores, stress-dependent shifting interiors or weighted lower components while the weapon remains conventionally readable.

#### Interpretation boundary
Sand coloring, mud texture or a character depicted sinking in scenery is not Quicksand. The unstable saturated granular state must be intrinsic anatomy.

### SC643 — Pressure
**Broad category:** Physical / Environmental  
**Disposition:** SELECTABLE CONCEPT ENTRY  

#### Core identity and distinguishing vocabulary
Force distributed over area, translated into compression, expansion, differential-pressure chambers, reinforced boundaries and pressure gradients through the body. Pressure is a general state variable; Shockwave is a moving discontinuity and Geyser is a hydrothermal pressure system.

**Body-system possibilities.** Pressure can inflate or compress selected anatomical chambers, thicken walls around high-pressure zones, flatten structures under external load, create diaphragms between regions of unequal pressure and alter joint spacing through pneumatic or hydraulic support. Hair and appendices may be hollow pressure-supported forms; torso depth can vary according to chamber pressure; cavities can be sealed and layered; limbs can taper where pressure drops. Both positive and negative relative pressure can be used if the body boundaries make the relation legible.

**Materialization modes.** pressurized chamber; compressed zone; inflated membrane; reinforced wall; diaphragm; pressure gradient; sealed cavity; hydraulic/pneumatic support.

**Body-regime range.** Supports petite high-pressure cores, soft inflated forms, broad chamber-heavy physiques, athletic hydraulic bodies and extreme pressure-supported hollow anatomy.

#### Symbiosis affordances
Partners may supply the contained medium, wall material, valves, porosity or external load. Pressure reciprocally compresses, expands, stiffens, bulges and stratifies partner systems.

#### Attractive / distinctive character potential
Powerful, sleek, soft, engineered, aquatic or alien female identities with unusual volume control.

#### Phase 2 — Outfit contribution
Outfits must avoid constraining pressure-dependent anatomy incorrectly and may respond structurally to chamber expansions or compressive zones.

#### Phase 3 — Weapon contribution
Pressure can influence chambers, diaphragms, compression reservoirs or thick-to-thin stress transitions in a conventional weapon.

#### Interpretation boundary
Bulky anatomy, air bubbles or vague force imagery are insufficient. Measurable pressure differences must visibly organize the body's own structures.
